name: Kdenlive
summary: A free video editor. Add clips, music, effects and subtitles.
gains: No watermark, no export limits, no media-hour caps
Built-in Whisper speech-to-text for automatic subtitles
Proper multitrack timeline, effects and color tools
tradeoffs: No "edit by deleting words in the transcript" like Descript
Takes an afternoon to learn the interface
setupSteps: Download Kdenlive from kdenlive.org and install it
Open Settings → Configure Kdenlive → Speech to Text and install the Whisper model
Import your clips and drag them onto the timeline
Use Project → Subtitles → Speech recognition to auto-generate captions
Export with Render → choose a YouTube/MP4 preset
